card.text: A Cepheid in the Milky Way, 108 times the Sun's width, that swells and shrinks every 26.0 days.

sources.label: Groenewegen (2012)
sources.locator: table10, X Pup: Per, Rad, Dist

introduction.text: Its mean radius, 107.7 solar radii, comes from comparing how fast its surface moves with how its size changes, 2,534 parsecs away.
